from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,plistlib,os,json
p=Path('/Volumes/Seagate 2TB');assert p.is_dir()
r=subprocess.run(['diskutil','info','-plist',str(p)],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
d=plistlib.loads(r.stdout);assert d['VolumeUUID']=='7C6E7CE1-D8D5-3041-AA58-DC000A724A29' and d['MountPoint']==str(p) and d['Writable']
s=os.statvfs(p);free=s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize;assert free>20*1024**3
print(json.dumps({'volumeUUID':d['VolumeUUID'],'mount':str(p),'writable':True,'freeBytes':free}))
